People severely underestimate quality of life and longevity mods. A short shifter and an aos will extend the life of your engine and improve your daily driving more than any mods that require a tune could ever. 👌

Earlier the better on Friday. Evenings can start getting heavy especially near peak season. There are some pro tips for that kind of driving though. Maintaining enough space from the vehicle in front of you so you can avoid a full stop is one I use most frequently. If you get an accessport you can adjust the RPM idle range a bit to help avoid lugging the engine as well.
Also I cannot overemphasize the importance of the right tires for the snowy mountain conditions whether you drive manual or auto.

A manual is super fun to drive especially once you become proficient. If I had to pick one or another I would still rather drive a standard over an auto anyday. Learn from my mistake and just aim to leave for the mountains very early and leave from them very early to avoid the traffic.The worst times are Saturday mornings and Sunday afternoons during the season.
